title: Ladies versus Butlers! Specials
justification: AniList 8302 (SPECIAL, 6 episode(s) from 2010-03-26) is AniDB 7009's special(s) S2-S7, aired 2010-03-26 to 2010-08-27. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 7009. After the parent's S1/S2 rows are corrected (see proposal), S2-S7 land on TVDB 0x1-0x6 'Special 1-6' (2010-03-26, 04-28, 05-28, 06-25, 07-30, 08-27).
